telemetry_data.notes: Used exclusively for numeric data, sparklines labels, timestamps, and sensor readouts.

colors.notes: ISA-101 compliant: monochrome grayscale baseline. DO NOT USE vibrant colors for normal states. Reserve amber and red ONLY for alarms and anomalies.

textures: Subtle grain texture or scanline overlay over the vision panel (ESP32-CAM) to simulate industrial CRT feeds.
shadows: No large diffuse shadows. Use sharp 1px borders and very subtle drop-shadows (e.g., shadow-[0_4px_12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]) for popovers/modals only.
visual_enhancers.borders: Sharp edges or max 2px-4px radius. Industrial, structural, precise.

grids_and_layouts.global_layout: Bento Grid Protocol - High Density Grid Mode B. Dense, data-heavy, grid-cols-12 system.
grids_and_layouts.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar for 'Scenario Selector' and 'System Connectivity'.
grids_and_layouts.main_content: Executive Summary Banner at the top. 4 interactive Splice Joint cards in a 2x2 or 1x4 grid. Deep Diagnostic Telemetry below.

executive_banner.description: Top marquee/banner. Shows belt speed, motor load, and active critical alerts marquee.
executive_banner.style: Dark gray background with red text for active critical alerts, gray text for normal telemetry.

global_health_score.description: Gauge (0-100) with 30-day trendline. Should look like industrial SCADA.
global_health_score.style: Grayscale arc, only colored if in warning/critical state.

splice_joint_cards.description: 4 cards (J1-J4). Contains health %, lifecycle, anomaly detected, and thumbnail.
splice_joint_cards.style: Flat, rectangular, 1px border. Changes border to red/amber if anomaly detected.

telemetry_charts.description: Tabbed time-series charts (Vibration, Thermal, Current, Isolation Forest).
telemetry_charts.style: Shadcn charts/Recharts. Lines must be grayscale. ISO 10816-3 severity bands (green/gray/yellow/red) subtly overlaid behind the line.

vision_panel.description: ESP32-CAM feed with CNN bounding boxes.
vision_panel.style: Image with absolute positioned div for bounding box (red border). CRT scanline effect over the image.

explainable_ai_cards.description: Expandable cards on alerts. Shows vibration + thermal + vision evidence, plus LLM maintenance recommendations.
explainable_ai_cards.style: Accordions or expandable cards. Industrial look.

motion.hover_states: Slight brightness increase. hover:bg-[#3A3E41]. Text color changes to white.
motion.entrance_animations: Staggered fade-in for cards. opacity-0 translate-y-4 to opacity-100 translate-y-0.
motion.telemetry_animations: Simulated live data moving from right to left on charts.

accessibility.contrast: APCA contrast compliant. Light gray text on charcoal background.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='scenario-loose-joint').

damaged_splice.description: Torn/Damaged conveyor belt splice thumbnail with visible tear.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or generic sans for text. Use IBM Plex Sans for UI, and JetBrains Mono for telemetry.
Strict ISA-101 compliance: Use monochrome grayscale for all normal states. Color (Red/Amber) is reserved strictly for anomalies, alarms, and bounding boxes.
Do not use Shadcn card with large border radius. Override rounded-lg or rounded-xl to rounded-sm or rounded-none.
Use mock data that simulates real industrial sensors (MPU6050, MLX90614, ACS712).
Include a sidebar or top selector to switch between scenarios: Normal, Loose Joint, Damaged Joint, Misalignment, Overload.
In the Vision panel, overlay a red CNN bounding box on the damaged joint image.
Ensure the dashboard background is a charcoal #1A1C1E, not pitch black.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds over content. Keep backgrounds solid.
All .js components should follow these guidelines. No .tsx files.
Use react-icons or lucide-react for iconography. DO NOT use generic emojis.
Make sure the 'Scenario Selector' updates all graphs and system states.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never apply universal transition like transition: all. Target specific properties.
Do not center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
Provide data-testid attributes on all buttons, selectors, and interactive elements.
Never use AI assistant Emojis for icons.
Never use placeholder URLs. Only use provided image_urls.
